description: Plays pleasant sounds for progress bars instead of NVDA's beeps: five built-in sounds (water drop, soft tick, marimba, bubble and success chime), or your own WAV files. Choose separate sounds for the start, halfway point and end of a progress bar, let the pitch rise and the sound move from left to right as progress goes up, and hear an announcement such as "Download complete" when a progress bar finishes. Settings are in NVDA menu, Preferences, Settings, Progress Pulse.
changelog:
* First release.
* Five built-in sounds (water drop, soft tick, marimba, bubble and success chime), or your own WAV files.
* Separate start, halfway and finished sounds.
* Pitch rises with progress; optional left-to-right stereo movement.
* Announces when a progress bar finishes, for example "Download complete".
* Sounds don't get choppy when several progress bars move at once, and can optionally overlap.
* Works with NVDA 2022.1 and later.
